short.lead: Seven steps, each its own sub-issue of issue #264 (Enforce the QA stage), built in this order. choices: stage
Where does the stage live so a new cloud session keeps it?
A
A committed file on the branch, .claude/house-rules-loop.json, that only the hook may change
Travels with the branch, and Write or Edit of it is refused.
B
Stay in .git, and accept a restart at Design in each new cloud session
No change, and the lock is lost between sessions.
C
On GitHub, as a label on the feature's issue
The hook can't read GitHub in a cloud session, because the GitHub command-line tool (gh) is not logged in here.
A is the only option that survives a new container without GitHub access. The feature already lives on one branch, so the stage belongs with it.
who
Who builds the steps?
A
@house-rules:builder helpers, one step at a time
Five of the seven steps change hook.py, so two helpers working at once would edit the same file.
B
I build them myself in this session
Faster to start, but the house rule says a settled plan goes to helpers.
The house rule hands each issue to a helper, and running them one after another keeps hook.py edits from overlapping.
